title: Multiple Inheritance
learning_outcomes: Describe the purpose and main behavior of multiple inheritance.
Apply multiple inheritance in a small Python example or interpret a representative result.
Identify one limitation, edge case, compatibility concern, or failure mode relevant to the topic.

content.intro: This lesson introduces multiple inheritance as part of python object-oriented programming. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: Object-oriented design is useful when state and behavior belong together. Prefer clear interfaces and composition when inheritance would create a fragile hierarchy.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Object-oriented design is useful when state and behavior belong together. Prefer clear interfaces and composition when inheritance would create a fragile hierarchy.
